Convert HTML forms with content to PDF. Lets visitors of your webpages convert the page including the form data they filled in to PDF, with just a single click.

kakao2 is an interactive weather map that allows users to view cloud cover and weather updates by manipulating a map of Asia.

Moveboxer is the best way to find a reputable mover and instantly get a quote for your move. Moveboxer combines Yelp ratings and reviews with a price estimate so users have more information along the way and can select the movers of their choice to get in touch with them.
100% Cloud-based mail-merge using data from BatchBook and Drawloop's SaaS mail-merge solution.
Import of times tracked via mite into the billing tool billomat.
Allows Box.net users to preview documents in their Box accounts using iPaper by Scribd.
This mashup allows Box.net users to load spreadsheet files directly from their Box accounts into EditGrid, where they can be viewed and edited, then saved back to a Box account.
This mashup allows Box.net users to send files directly from their Box accounts to Drawloop, where they are converted into PDFs.
Convert almost any kind of document to PDF.
A site for viewing the most common document types in a simple and fast way. View documents without having to install software, plus share in different ways and convert to PDF.

A demo site built to show the ease of implementing BeenVerified with IPaper. IPaper was used to display resumes, and the BeenVerified API was used to demo the OAuth process of displaying verified user data.

A PowerPoint mixer to select a PowerPoint presentation on the fly from SlideShare. It uses the SlideShare.net API and pretty effects by script.aculo.us and prototype.js to select a random slideshow for a given tag.
Mashup satellite images from BBC Weather and t7online. See the Instructions tab to see how to do it.
Stockaholic uses the EditGrid dynamic images to mashup charts from Yahoo Finance. See the Instructions tab to see how to do it.
A NYUAD Hackathon project that shows routes with landmarks.
Online classifieds and advertisements service with video and Google Maps. Users can post video footage of their classifieds and ads, along with images and audio. View classifieds and ads on a map.

Voyager Accountable Messaging allows developers to create intelligent, location-based applications for iPhone, Android, BlackBerry and most consumer electronic devices. Provides a universal set of APIs including Twilio and Twilio SMS.
Google Apps and Box.net are integrated, so Google Apps users can access their Box files from within Gmail, create file-based events in Google Calendar, and create Google Sites with content from Box.
Use the MyShopping application for Facebook to connect with friends, co-workers, or family on your daily shopping activities.

Installable software (currently private beta) to help you learn more about your community thanks to different search criteria and filters that can be applied to your followers and friends. SocialBro's technology allows you to download all your community to your PC and browse them even if you are offline. SocialBro will be available as an Adobe Air desktop application and as a Google Chrome App.
A free classified site for RVs and trailers. This mashup makes use of the Oodle, Google AdSense, and Google Maps APIs.
4sqoogle is an easy and user-friendly mashup that lists foursquare points of interest and plots them on a Google Map. Discover and recommend food, nightlife, entertainment and shopping in your city.
A tool developed by the Nexmo community that will make it super easy to blast your SMS campaign from a simple Excel file.
A Twitter Trends dashboard that, at a glance, shows you whatâ€™s happening across geographyâ€™s using trending topics on Twitter.
A realtime map of Northern Lights locations and photos. See the current aurora forecast and latest Flickr and Twitter posts related to the Aurora Borealis.

FlowTest allows you to test OpenVBX Call Flows - as well as the text-to-speech engine - using the new OpenVBX Browser Phone. Instead of dialing in multiple times as you tweak your flows, you can can now test without even using your phone. When you start testing, the OpenVBX Browser Phone will ring, but once it's answered, you can continue to test different flows or the text-to-speech engine while the call is ongoing.
Upload and share your GPS-Tracks. Over 13000 tracks for Mountain biking, Hiking, Biking, Climbing and others.
Useful mashup that lets you see who has been donating money to which political party by zip code. Good combination of raw data, charts and maps. Data source is The Fundrace Project.

Connected with the Walgreens Balance Rewards program, this fitbit application allow users to keep track of their activity to earn Walgreens points. With a 'steps' program, customers will be able to set goals and view progress of their activities, while earning reward points at Walgreens.
Allows Box.net users to view analytics about files they have shared through Box.

Enter 1 song, get 150 similar songs back, create your own MTV. Combines Last.FM & Youtube. There's also a Facebook integration that let you discover music your friends like. Uses Bit.ly in order to share playlist urls.

Sunday Morning Rides is an interactive community portal for motorcycle riders to access, explore, plan, and share motorcycle tracks via a ride mapping system that combines GPS, geographic information systems, database, and Google mapping technologies.
Multiple ways to browse random images from Flickr: all, interestingness, photostreams, groups, etc.
Thank to Wikipedia, descriptions of cities are embedded into description box. At the end of the content there's a backlink pointing to the source.
Help us build the best source for healthy living and local news by submitting your tips, events and links so that we can all learn to live a more eco-friendly lifestyle.
Like Google Instant, but this uses Twitter's Search API to search Twitter instantly. As the user types, this mashup quickly provides tweet results.
Guide for businesses and service providers in Switzerland with community integration.
A 30-minute snapshot of Singapore Traffic Conditions through 40 island-wide cameras. Particularly interesting are the Causeway and 2nd Link cameras, where you can find heavier traffic flow.
Dial a phone number and log the call in the Microsoft Dynamics CRM 2011 system using ClicktoDial.
Photoree aims to be to photos what Last.fm is to music and StumbleUpon to websites. It adapts to your preferences and taste, recommending to you the best images that may interest you.
Gooogle Maps Mashup displays public broadcast coverage overlays, and allows users to look up demographic information for all broadcast facilities, radio and TV.
Japanese Umeshu (plum wine) community web site.
Tweets live on Google Maps.
This mashup allows Box.net users to create physical mailers directly from their Box accounts using pictures they have stored.

The Sanders Standard offers updated media news related to Bernie Sanders. This mashup uses the Webhose.io API to deliver a constant stream of coverage from several sources such as Bloomberg, Politico, and The Guardian.
Profileomat is a shareable Profile Aggregator that lists all your personal Websites, Social Networks, Blogs, Contact Info, Photo Albums and other Profiles in a box. Formerly called linkmybox.com
Easy way to listen music.
Search the prices on 43,000 hotels worldwide. Filter hotels to suit your needs and then make reservations.

Salonist software is a smart tool for handling salon services and activities. With the help of this tool, salon owners can earn more profits and also can streamline their business operations. Its inventory management feature helps to manage the inventory of the salon products.
Calculates the distance between any 2 cities in the world and creates day routes between landmarks for major cities.

TextWeight is a simple way to track and see your body weight over time. The service will send you a text message in the morning; reply with your weight. Login to the site anytime to see a graph of your weight.
What will my utility bill be after solar? Does solar make sense for me? Enter your zip code and find out!

This is a mashup in Ruby language created with World Weather Online and Twilio features. It allows users to interact with the APIs to receive weather forecast. For more information, contact third party developer JForaker on Github.
Wikia Game Guides is a mobile application that offers walkthroughs, tips, cheats and guides to users for their games.
Enthusem is a service that allows users to send physical greeting cards online. Through its integration with Box.net, users can send cards containing content from their Box.net files.

Because the Web is full of poorly written articles, The Article Checker will check an article along four dimensions and grade its value. The highest graded articles get a permanent backlink from this page so rank up!
Real-time schedules and rider alerts from Metro Transit on iPhone, Android, and Windows Mobile devices

Birdsearch enables users to super their search on Twitter. Search tool on twitter is a gold mine for surfacing the most ¥aluable tweets, whether it's the top tweets, most engaged tweets, viral tweets, tweets from specific users, media, news etc, it makes it easier to separate the signal substance from the noise. However, Twitter search has been stagnant for many years in terms of refining the search, the UX and one cannot construct their own advanced search queries on mobile, which is where Bird search comes in.
An interactive map to find and add ping pong tables worldwide. For the animation, jQuery was used. The app is optimized for iPhone/iPod Touch as well.
Simple and intuitive search tool, allows displaying photo time and date taken in either a radial or standard X,Y axis plot.
Visually see your twitter followers in a tree.
Social networking travel websites that creates personalized recommendations for each user based on user interests and user ratings. Uses geotagged Flickr photo stream and Google maps.
Search millions of local and international movie titles and video trailers from YouTube. Also has links to Google for more information about your search term.
Like tinyurl, but for maps. Create a map, add routes or points of interest, and get a short URL to share it or come back to it later.
This mashup uses Google Maps to display a detailed illustration of the Vinexpo 2013 facilities. This allows visitors to easily find exactly what they are looking for.
A coupon deal website.
Online bed and breakfast directory with listings worldwide, travel gift certificates and Blog.
STEL Order is an invoicing web application that provides businesses a way to securely synchronize their data on the cloud. This application uses Fakturoid API.
A mashup GeoRSS feeds, the new Google AJAX Feed API and Google Maps. News from a number of sources is plotted on a Google Map. Live streaming video is also available from a number of news sources.
Contextualizing and situating the list of prisons and the human rights abuses in Tunisia. Mashup of database data with Google Maps, YouTube, Flash animations and Yahoo Q Beta search.
At Shoptweets we scan twitter so you can see what what real people are saying about real stores in real-time.
This shows photos of Flickr in Google Maps API Interface, not on map. You can search by tag, text and username.
Showing Supinfo, a graduate school of computer science, in different cities in France, China, Canada and the UK.
This experiment is about relating flickr.com or del.icio.us user to each other based on usage of similar tags.

Mashup of Google Maps, Virtual Earth with many other APIs. Ext.js is used to make user interface intuitive. It lets you search for hotels, photos, restaurants, wifi spots, local news/blogs, events, weather, and many other spatial data.
Find celebrity videos, especially for Latin stars. Uses the YouTube API. Note that some videos are adult content and not safe for work, NSFW.

Through Our Dictionary You can translate text from and to more than 51 Languages easily ,With just one click you get double translation one from Google translator Other from Bing translator two are completely different so you can compare between them and choose best translation for you .
Share code with developers through Twitter. Provided as a plugin for Eclipse (initially), use it to select a file or snippet of text in an editor and share it on Twitter.
An open source free Java Point of Sale system for restaurants. To ensure fast development and scalability, Floreant POS used the Flickr API and Google Custom Search engine.
Interactive Google Map of the Montreal subway system with links to the Montreal Transit Website.

Weather Center is the weather app that has all the data users will ever need. It tracks general weather including summary and detailed forecasts. It also provides users with information on severe weather including storm reports, NWS watches and warnings, storm cell tracking and more.
Mashup of job postings, interview questions and answers for easy job search and preparation.
Classified listing service for boat slips and marinas. Uses Google Maps API for precise mapping and geosearching.
Provides tracking information of Australia Post parcels, with visualized parcel locations on Google Maps.
TodoToday Pro for Cohuman is a todo list application to show current due and overdue tasks from the online task management tool Cohuman.com.
Compare Prices website based on the eBay Commerce API platform. Site is fully responsive and can adapt to any screen size including mobile.

Sign virtually any email attachment with DocuSign Ink. The DocuSign Ink Outlook plugin installs indirectly into the Outlook Home tab enabling you to instantly sign and return documents directly from your Outlook email.
Yelp Local Business Search is an application that allows users to search for local businesses by providing their location. This application uses the Yelp API service.
Mashup of Citysearch and Google Maps to help find the best restaurants, hotels, nightlife, shopping and services in major US cities as voted on Citysearch.com.
A service where you can share opinions about products, services and people. Tell others what brands matter and don't matter to you. Then see how other people have matterized those same brands.

A mash up of a broadband checker, Google Maps and Yahoo AJAX. Maps the distance to your exchange and calculates the speed of an ADSL connection as shows a list of broadband providers in the area. NOTE: Jan 07 appears down.
Notify is a note-taking application for the iPad, and through its integration with Box.net, users can upload their notes directly to a Box account.
A tool for reverse IP lookup. This site's language is Turkish.
Tag your photos and place them on the Google Map by uploading them on Panorama Explorer. Search photos by geo data or just exploring the map.
